title: How to not walk while using your phone
subject: Getting around

text: How to not walk while using your phone
A short course on keeping your eyes up.
The phone can wait. The curb cannot.
If you need the phone, stop walking. Step out of the flow of people. Then look at the screen.
A message is not urgent because it arrived.
Walking is a job. Reading is a job. Do one.
Headphones make this worse. You lose the sound of a bike, a cart, or someone saying excuse me.
Not on stairs. Not at a crossing. Not on a platform edge.
If you are moving through a door, a station, or a crowd, the phone stays in your pocket.
You are at a crossing and a message arrives. What do you do?

choices.label: Stop, step back from the curb, then read it
Read it while you cross. It is short.
Keep walking and answer by voice

text: Stop walking before you look. One job at a time. Stay off the phone on stairs, crossings, and platform edges.
